verdict.rationale: A customer account says Datadog correlates APM, custom metrics and logs via tagging and densely links them across the platform. The first-party APM and Log Management items are only titles, though, with no documented trace-to-logs/metrics pivot. One critic calls the correlation weak compared to rivals, but that is an opinion rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence instead of creating a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of jumping from a span to its correlated logs and metrics, details on how trace-log ID injection works, and hands-on corroboration of end-to-end request debugging.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: correlating data across APM, custom metrics and logs via tagging, densely linked across the platform
